name: fact-dimension-join-ordering
description: Measure deterministic ordered hash JOIN materialization and pagination

queries.name: first-joined-page
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 25

queries.name: later-joined-page
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 25 OFFSET 25

queries.name: grouped-join-sort
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.country FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY a.country, e.event_id LIMIT 25

queries.name: reverse-join-sort
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY a.tier DESC, e.event_id ASC LIMIT 25
